name: Luck Blade
summary: A +1 sword that grants +1 to saving throws, rerolls a failed D20 Test once a day, and may hold a Wish.

stats.effect:
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While the weapon is on your person, you also gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.

***Luck.*** If the weapon is on your person, you can call on its luck (no action required) to reroll one failed {ref:glossary/d20-test} if you don't have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition. You must use the second roll. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

***Wish.*** The weapon has 1d3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge and cast *{ref:spell/wish}* from it. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn. The weapon loses this property if it has no charges.
